messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then, and the Ember team never held it. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2025-05-23 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-23]
- The INC-2026-009 follow-up decision on 2026-05-08 decided that the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan. [decision; valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-06-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-19-notifier]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-04 to 2025-06-19; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer lives with Team Dune; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-21]
